title: Enya
scene: Irish Celtic-rooted new age; BBC The Celts score, recorded in London and Dublin
notes: Celtic documentary melodies blend electronic textures, ceremonial voices and occasional acoustic soloists.

title: Watermark
scene: Late-1980s Irish Celtic-new-age crossover and atmospheric studio pop
notes: Extensive vocal overdubs and synthesized pizzicato contrast with slow rubato piano and Celtic pipes.

title: Shepherd Moons
scene: Early-1990s Irish Celtic new age and ambient pop
notes: Orchestral keyboard colours, layered vocals and waltz motion frame melancholic songs and traditional melodies.

title: The Memory of Trees
scene: Mid-1990s Irish Celtic new age and mythological atmospheric pop
notes: Mythology and multilingual vocals deepen the established keyboard-led sound with quiet ceremonial grandeur.
